entities.title: Semantic scenarios
entities.summary: 94 semantic scenarios: 62 falsehoods (one per row of spec/FALSEHOODS-MATRIX.md) and 32 from the standards review (STD-001 … STD-032).
entities.purpose: States the semantic behaviour every engine must eventually satisfy: the expected outcome of validation, resolution, comparison or transformation for each known falsehood and standards construct.
boundaries: Requirements, not executable tests: no scenario has inputs, a context or an expected result envelope yet (OI-12).
A scenario's status describes the fixture itself (design-test-required, design-requirement-not-implemented), not any library.
